title: Nicely Browned Slovakian Pork Roast
description: A comforting, savory, and flaky Slovakian dish featuring barbeque sauce and caramelized onions. Perfect for a Sunday dinner.

ingredients.name: unsweetened applesauce
ingredients.notes: helps to keep the meat moist

instructions: Rub the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, and caraway seeds, then coat with flour.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat, add oil and brown the pork shoulder on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork to a roasting pan, add sliced onions and garlic around the pork, and pour in the barbeque sauce.
Cover the pan with a lid and roast in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the onions are caramelized.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the pork with the caramelized onions and applesauce.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as mashed potatoes or braised red cabbage.
Chill any leftovers in the refrigerator within 2 hours of cooking and reheat safely to 74°C (165°F).
